reconciliation.boundaryMethod: Point-in-polygon against five-state Census county inventory in EPSG:4326, 0.00005-degree generalization; ambiguous and invalid locations stay unresolved.

attribution: Camera images courtesy of ODOT and TripCheck partner agencies. County classification: U.S. Census Bureau TIGERweb 2026.
limitations: An independent viewer, not an official ODOT service.
Counts are published views and source-reported locations, not independently verified physical devices.
Provider capture timestamps are not machine-readable in this public inventory; fetched times are not capture times.
Official rapid-image sessions are not embedded live video.
No API key is needed for the permitted public still-image integration; credentialed API feeds are separate.
auditScope: Historical individual-view checks retained only for unchanged image identities; new or changed image URLs remain unchecked until audited.
